compute.G1: 200 queries x 8 candidates x 2 arms ~ 6 h on two cores
compute.G2: the extra candidates of a 16-way all-class shortlist ~ 7 h more
compute.measured: ~14 s per match, ~11 s per build (Mission 10 + this session)
compute.staging: G1 pairs first for all 200 queries, then the extra G2 pairs; one row per (query, reference) so nothing is recomputed

corpus: data/ETH-80-master (8 classes x 10 instances x 41 views)

freshness.note: a (instance, view) pair is what Mission 10 scored; these views had none

G1.rule: the eight instances of the query's own class

G2.chance: 1/16 given the truth is shortlisted; recall measured
G2.rule: top 16 of all 64 references by node-similarity sum on a fixed 60 x 120 node subsample

gallery.instances: ranks 0-7 of each class (the same eight the Mission-10 gallery used, so the two missions ask the same question)

mde.formula: MDE = 2.8 * SE of the paired per-instance difference
mde.planned: 200 queries over 64 instances; at a planning discordance of 0.20 on top-1, SE ~ sqrt(0.20/64) = 0.056, MDE ~ 0.16

mission: 11 step 4 -- ETH-80 view-to-view retrieval, fresh queries
primary_contrast: C - A, paired per query, clustered by INSTANCE
secondary: C - A on the all-class gallery
coverage: share of mapped pairs judged, per arm and class

weight.fit: FIT only; ML degenerate at the bound, declared tie-break = FIT top-1, ties to the smaller weight
